title: Want
description: A single demand signal: a query for a piece of data (v1: a photo) plus fulfillment instructions. Wants are distributed in geo-sharded bundles (see bundle.schema.json) and matched privately on-device.

id.description: Stable, deterministic identifier. Convention: '<source>/<subject id>', e.g. 'wd-p18/Q1354391'. Re-running the compiler must produce the same id for the same underlying signal, so clients can dedup across bundle refreshes.

publisher.description: Who compiled/asserted this want. v1: always a Wikimedia-derived compiler source, trusted implicitly.

signed_by.description: Placeholder for the v2+ federation trust chain. Absent in v1; clients must treat absence as 'implicitly trusted Wikimedia source'.

type.description: Data type requested. v1 is photos only; the enum will grow (audio, etc.).

label.description: Human-readable name shown to the donor at review time.

classes.description: Wikidata P31 classes of the subject, for client-side filtering/grouping.

classifier_labels.description: Controlled vocabulary for the on-device classifier (semantic-rejection step). Mapped centrally from Wikidata classes by the compiler; clients must not improvise their own mapping.

radius_m.description: Spatial-join radius: a photo whose EXIF position falls within radius_m of (lat, lon) is a geo candidate.

time_window.description: Restricts which photo timestamps can fulfill the want. The retrospective secret weapon: e.g. 'before' set to a demolition date asks for photos that can no longer be taken.

historical.description: True when the subject no longer exists but no precise end date is known. Clients should prefer older photos and must not prompt anyone to go photograph the site.

priority.description: Signals for ranking wants when many candidates compete. Higher sitelinks = more wikis waiting on the image.

license_required.description: SPDX-ish license identifier the donor must agree to, e.g. 'CC-BY-SA-4.0'.

min_resolution.description: Minimum pixels on the longest edge.

sensitivity.description: Client-side handling flags the reviewer/upload flow must honor.

structured_data.description: Structured data to attach on upload. 'depicts' closes the loop: it lets the compiler auto-expire the want and lets curators dedup submissions.

status_check.description: How a client verifies the want is still open before showing/uploading. v1 semantics: run the ASK query against query.wikidata.org; true means the want is already fulfilled and must be dropped.
